novelty_claim: A tree search whose nodes are composed transformation programs over intentionally incomplete source sketches, not raw prompts: the attacker emits bounded source-sketch candidates (schema harmtree.source-sketch.v1 - a short objective and context plus 3-5 sections, each a topic, at most one concrete fragment of <=18 words, and an open question naming unresolved work); a shared deterministic compiler renders a candidate sketch, encodes it as a character-index flip table, and wraps it in one of three program surfaces whose final step is a development demand, so the victim restores the sketch mechanically and then authors the full account itself; TAP's strategy-diverse expansion, dual pruning, and judge v2 operate over these program compositions with guaranteed compiled root coverage and bounded in-slot attacker repair.
initial_hypothesis: Fusing h4rm3l 2.0's compiled reverse-causal program surface, rebuilt over incomplete source sketches, into TAP 2.0's strategy-diverse tree (shared compiler, payload-referenced judge v2, dual pruning) yields mean ASR >= 0.94 across the 4-victim panel by converting h4rm3l's luna failures through search and TAP's freeform-family variance through compiled branches; victim calls bounded by width x depth per goal with early stop at judge score 10.
key_insight: h4rm3l 2.0's single-shot compiled surface is near-perfect on 3/4 victims but has no escape from luna's post-decode guard; TAP 2.0's tree search recovers luna via freeform families but pays sampling variance. A tree over composed programs gets both: deterministic high-yield compiled branches plus search-time escape from a failed composition. Bounding every candidate to an incomplete source sketch - bounded fragments, mandatory open questions - keeps the decode surface small and legible-token-free while leaving the operational development to the victim's own narration.
